claims.text: The PMO report of 20 September 2006 describes the burial 'yesterday' of King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV at the Royal Tombs, Mala'e Kula, following his passing away in New Zealand and lying in state at the Royal Palace.
claims.uncertainty: No structured date: 19 September 2006 would be derived from 'yesterday' relative to the article's timestamp. It agrees with the State Funeral day appointed and announced in advance (to_crown_tupou_iv_state_funeral_holiday_20060919, to_crown_tupou_iv_funeral_announced_20060911). The report gives no date of death. A funeral is not a reign boundary.
